files.caption: Two photographs of 315 Shafor Street, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 315 Shafor street reads: Attractive, well maintained, 3-bedroom home situated on a corner lot. Large living room, den, full dining room, modern kitchen down. Three corner bedrooms with large closets and newly remodeled bath on second. Full basement with new gas furnace. Built-in garage. Downstairs carpeting remains with property. Close to schools, parks and bus. Call for appointment.
